entry.title: Singer Building

buildingCutout.basis: Replace One Liberty Plaza when the Singer Building is selected by historical date.

entry.note: Exterior reconstruction of the 1908 Singer and Bourne complex. Façade relief, colors, rear elevations and rooftop service structures are approximations. Historical date mode retains the present-day street network, terrain and buildings outside the selected modern One Liberty Plaza footprint. Historical placement requires an explicit viewingDate within the recorded appearance interval; excluded from the default current world.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
